sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, as part of rolling initiative.

system.description:
You quickly dash forward as you draw your sword with the intent to finish the battle before it begins. Move into a space you can see within your movement speeds range. At the end of that movement, make a melee taijutsu attack against a creature within your weapons range. On a hit, you deal your [Weapon Damage] + 4d6 and for the affected creature to make a Wisdom saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is Dazzled.

Failure: Affected creature is Dazzled and loses their Reaction until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the affected creature also loses their Action.

Ideal Cut: Roll 1d6. On a roll of 5 or 6, you regain your spent Reaction.

Tao: Roll 1d6, on a roll of 5 or 6, you gain an additional Bonus action on your first turn in combat.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 the damage by 1d6.
